description.value:
Critical damage bonus +4. Party Mask grants critical threshold −1 and critical damage bonus +2 for 3 turns at combat start. After restoring 4 total SP, refresh Mask for 4 turns and reset the counter.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching harmony Path required.
